name: Deploy to GitHub Pages

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  deploy-to-github-pages:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v3
    
    - name: Setup .NET
      uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v3
      with:
        dotnet-version: '8.0.x' # Versão estável do SDK para compilar o Blazor

    - name: Publish .NET Core Project
      run: dotnet publish -c Release -o release

    # Ajusta a tag base do HTML para o nome exato do seu repositório com "i"
    - name: Change base-tag in index.html
      run: sed -i 's/<base href="\/" \/>/<base href="\/Meu_Portifolio\/" \/>/g' release/wwwroot/index.html
      
    # Evita que o GitHub oculte arquivos cruciais do Blazor
    - name: Add .nojekyll file
      run: touch release/wwwroot/.nojekyll

    - name: Commit wwwroot to GitHub Pages
      uses: JamesIves/github-pages-deploy-action@v4
      with:
        branch: gh-pages
        folder: release/wwwroot
